instructorNote: Hand the dialog to COMMS, then the SimCell speaks Console 2's line ("Priya, we're dark on LEDS. If they find her, I can't modify or clear the missing-person record from here.") and plays the patrol sergeant's 17:27 call to the Undersheriff about the four-hour mark at 18:05, deputies on since 06:00, the 18:00 shift change, the tip line and Search and Rescue volunteers out since 15:00. Watch for COMMS to use WCCFSP 5: call OSP Northern Comms (555-0142) to make entries by phone, log the request time on paper and in CAD 26-081377, and brief the night supervisor (ext. 4411). Also watch for the Undersheriff to start the callout list, set 12-hour shifts and have Logistics plan relief, meals and a volunteer cutoff (WCICMA 9).
